MATCH (t:Team)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document), (o:Owner)-[:Owns]->(t)
WHERE o.name = 'William Chisholm'
RETURN t.founded_year AS col1, o.name AS col2, t.team_name AS col3, t.team_name AS name_team
ORDER BY CAST(t.founded_year AS INT64)

MATCH (t:Team)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document), (o:Owner)-[:Owns]->(t)
WHERE o.name CONTAINS 'William Chisholm'
RETURN t.founded_year AS col1, o.name AS col2, t.team_name AS col3, t.team_name AS name_team
ORDER BY CAST(t.founded_year AS INT64)

MATCH (o:Owner)-[:Owns]->(t:Team)
WHERE o.name CONTAINS 'Chisholm'
RETURN t.founded_year AS col1, o.name AS col2, t.team_name AS col3, t.team_name AS name_team

MATCH (o:Owner)-[:Owns]->(t:Team)

ORDER BY CAST(t.founded_year AS INT64)
